messages:
Maya: Pulled strict fncall validator on canary (eu) after spike in unexpected_array rejects.
Jon: saw it. Any adapter or model variant correlation?
Maya: looks like the legacy webhook adapters returning arrays triggered the validator. Spike ~6% reject rate.
Aria: We need aggregated reject reasons in Console (no raw payloads). Support currently gets only generic 4xx.
Jon: Plan: emit reason_code enum into metrics pipeline, sample 1% raw snapshots, surface top reasons in a redacted Validator Insights card behind a feature flag.
Maya: Also add billable_status tag so finance can reconcile.
DeployBot: Alert created: fncall_reject_rate_eu_canary > 2% for 5m -> notify #eng-oncall.
Aria: I'll mock the Console card. Jon: telemetry PR? Maya: I'll own rollout policy and runbook.
Jon: Cool. Re-enable strict canary after telemetry + console surfacing + auto-rollback threshold in place.
Maya: Closing thread, will update with PR links.
